decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. It aims to control the board early on with cards like Fatal Push and Bonecrusher Giant, while disrupting the opponent's hand with Thoughseize. The deck also utilizes powerful finishers such as Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to close out games quickly. By combining aggressive threats with disruptive spells, this deck looks to put pressure on the opponent from the beginning and maintain control throughout the match.

The main concept of this deck is to build a strong board presence quickly by ramping up mana with mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, then utilizing devotion to green with cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to cast powerful green creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns. The deck also includes ways to tutor for key pieces with cards like Oath of Nissa and Karn, the Great Creator, and has a toolbox of powerful green spells like Storm the Festival to further support its aggressive game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Elvish Mystic, Llanowar Elves, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to play powerful green cards with high devotion. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn, while also using planeswalkers like Karn, the Great Creator and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to generate additional value. The deck also includes cards like Storm the Festival and Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God for added versatility and finishing power.

This deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects to deal damage to the opponent while generating value from creatures entering and leaving the battlefield. It aims to control the board through removal spells and steal opponent's threats with Claim the Firstborn. Mayhem Devil and Bloodtithe Harvester are key cards that synergize well with sacrificing creatures. The deck also includes disruption like Thoughseize and removal like Fatal Push to disrupt opponents' game plan. Jegantha, the Wellspring can be cast from outside the game for additional value.

The deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to transform lower cost creatures into powerful threats to control the board. It also utilizes Fires of Invention to cast spells for free and gain advantage, with Leyline Binding and Temporary Lockdown to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck includes a variety of powerful creatures and enchantments to provide versatility and win conditions, such as Koma, Cosmos Serpent and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. Overall, the key concept is to control the game through powerful creatures, enchantments, and disruptive spells while setting up a strong board presence.

This aggro deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix multiple times throughout the game. The deck includes cards like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to trigger the Phoenix's ability, while also incorporating draw spells like Opt and Pieces of the Puzzle to find necessary pieces. The inclusion of Treasure Cruise and Temporal Trespass allows for card advantage and potential extra turns to push through damage. With a mix of burn spells, cantrips, and Phoenix recursion, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with quick and consistent threats.

This deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects and synergies to overwhelm the opponent with constant pressure and damage. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and utilizing effects like Mayhem Devil and Witch's Oven, the deck aims to chip away at the opponent's life total while controlling the board. With cards like Claim the Firstborn and Fatal Push for removal, as well as Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Bloodtithe Harvester for additional damage, the deck has a high level of aggression and resilience. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional mana fixing and flexibility in the deck's strategy.

The main concept of the deck is to control the game through a combination of removal spells, instant-speed interaction, and card draw, while also utilizing powerful threats like Crackling Drake to finish off the opponent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and outvalue them with efficient spells and card advantage. Hall of Storm Giants and Otawara, Soaring City provide strong finishers if the game goes long, making it a versatile and adaptable control deck in the Pioneer format.

This deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to control the board and summon powerful creatures. It includes a variety of Triomes to ensure mana consistency and supports the strategy with Leyline Binding and Temporary Lockdown to disrupt opponents. The deck includes a mix of creatures with powerful abilities such as Koma, Cosmos Serpent and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. The inclusion of Fires of Invention allows for explosive plays while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides additional card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and control the game until victory.

The main focus of this deck is to generate large amounts of green mana through devotion to green, utilizing Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves. The deck aims to ramp quickly into powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll, while using cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to support the aggressive strategy. Storm the Festival helps find key creatures, while Lair of the Hydra and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional utility. The deck is designed to overwhelm opponents with big green threats early in the game.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced, aggressive strategy focused on tempo plays and Spirit tribal synergies. By utilizing cards like Rattlechains and Spell Queller to disrupt the opponent's plans while maintaining a strong board presence with Mausoleum Wanderer and Spectral Sailor, the deck aims to close out games quickly with evasive threats like Shacklegeist and Supreme Phantom. Curious Obsession provides card advantage and helps maintain pressure, while cards like Lofty Denial and Geistlight Snare offer protection and interaction. Card draw and mana fixing are also key elements of the deck's strategy.
